描述_EN: her figure originated in india as the male deity avalokitesvara, bodhisattva of compassion; after the introduction of buddhism in china, he was transformed into a female deity associated to motherly virtues of piety. like other bodhisattvas, she wears jewellery on the head, torso and arms; on the head, the elaborately worked diadem has in the centre a lotus pedestal, formerly meant for an amitabha figure now missing. guanyin, which literally means 'she who listens to the sound', is one of the most popular buddhist deities in china. in this image, guanyin is portrayed seated in the pose known as lalitasana, or 'royal ease'.
描述_ZN: her figure originated in india as the male deity avalokitesvara, bodhisattva of compassion; after the introduction of buddhism in china, he was transformed into a female deity associated to motherly virtues of piety. like other bodhisattvas, she wears jewellery on the head, torso and arms; on the head, the elaborately worked diadem has in the centre a lotus pedestal, formerly meant for an amitabha figure now missing. 观音，字面意思是 "聆听声音的人"，是中国最受欢迎的佛教神灵之一。 在这幅画中，观世音菩萨是以被称为Lalitasana的姿势坐着的，或者说是 "皇家的轻松"。
